name: br.com.bemobi.medescope.service.impl.DownloadCommandService
description: The Bemobi Medescope download library starts this service when the app queues or cancels a file, requests progress, or handles a finished download. It submits downloads to Android Download Manager and reports progress and results to the app.
disableEffect: Files downloaded through Medescope may not start, cancel, or report progress and results correctly, breaking app features that use those downloads.
